Iris: proposal: introduce a 'semantic guard' routing layer that can automatically divert traffic to a conservative variant when quality signals degrade. Not latency-only.
Sam: what signals do we track? safety violations, factuality checks, hallucination heuristics?
Iris: yes. small ensemble: safety_count, factuality_score, instruction-following_score. feed a tiny evaluator on sampled responses and compute a combined health metric.
Nadia: how to sample without huge cost?
Iris: sample ~0.5-1% of inferences, run evaluator async on a cheap CPU distil model. Keep a sliding window (configurable). Router subscribes to health stream and applies a declarative policy expression.
Lee: concrete policy example?
Iris: healthExpression: "0.6*median(factuality)+0.3*(1-safety_count_normalized)+0.1*(1-latency_penalty)", trigger if < 0.6 over 3m and minSamples=40, cooldown=8m.
Sam: how does this relate to canary/A-B triggers? precedence needs to be explicit.
Iris: precedence plan: infra alarms (errors/timeouts) > latency SLOs > canary health checks > semantic guard > manual. Semantic guard should not preempt a canary that owns >25% of traffic unless explicitly allowed.
Nadia: who owns golden prompts and tenant seeds?
Iris: Eng-ML curates canonical golden sets. Tenants may opt-in to supply anonymized seed prompts that rotate daily. Access via Console with audit logs.
Lee: rollout safety: I'd like shadowing on first flip to collect diffs.
Iris: agreed. Flip flow: detect -> shadow 30s -> if shadow diffs acceptable, promote; otherwise revert and escalate. Emit event: "semantic.guard.<model>.<region>" to eventbus with {score,samples,action} but scrub PII and rate-limit.
Sam: observability: per-route graph of healthMetric, sampleCount, recent sample pairs (redacted), and switch history.
Nadia: ops: add emergency global kill switch and thresholded auto-escalation to oncall if >2 auto-flips in 12h. Also add postmortem checklist entry.
Iris: anti-abuse: randomize prompt picks, rotate golden set, and validate evaluator monthly against an offline reference set to detect evaluator drift.
Lee: metrics for pilot: false-positive rate target <2%, cost overhead <4% of inference spend, mean time to recover <5m after misflip.
Iris: pilot plan: small internal model + 3 non-critical tenants for 4 weeks. If metrics pass, expand. I'll write the RFC with config schema, sample Console mockups, and a pilot playbook.
Sam: thanks. +1 to pilot.
health-bot: semantic-evaluator v0.1 deployed to staging at 2024-12-02T09:40:00Z."
